The '''artisan colony''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]]. It was founded by [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists who wanted to stay out of the violence of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] and instead focus on art and beauty.

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] was invaded by a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] named [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] with the aide of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. He took control of the city and the colonists were enslaved and transported to [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. Ten planetary rotations later, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived in the city to try to remove the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] from power. Kenobi tried to negotiate with D'Nar in the [[Governor's tower/Legends|governor's tower]], but D'Nar threatened Kenobi with [[Thermal annihilator bomb/Legends|bombs]] placed around the city. After he detonated one in order to prove his point, injuring several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]], Kenobi distracted D'Nar while Anakin Skywalker, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] disabled the rest of the bombs during the [[Battle of Kiros]]. When D'Nar learned that his plan had failed, he fled and was ultimately captured.

After all the colonists were rescued, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] announced his people's intention to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].
